latest_audits.result: OPA already runs the same official v0/v1 semantic corpus through topdown and a compile-to-exact-Wasm-bytes SDK route against common expected outcomes, so broad cross-backend conformance is stronger than a simple missing-test narrative. Strict builtin errors and named >64-bit/integer cases are explicit target-specific non-equivalence regions, so generated differential testing requires a semantic projection rather than blind equality. Issue 8124 confirms that `opa eval -t wasm`/rego.Target("wasm") is a compilation-target path and is not a substitute for executing the exact deployed Wasm artifact. Swift-OPA independently executes OPA-derived IR plans and is useful for IR-execution triangulation, but cannot independently validate Rego-to-IR lowering. Targeted searches did not establish a seeded generated topdown-vs-exact-Wasm differential/shrinking harness; that proposed layer remains unexecuted evidence, not an observed capability.

latest_audits.result: Official conditional-CTM code implements the fixed-calibration DKW-adjusted martingale with pinned dependencies. Independent calculation reproduced the worker's two-score KL=1 minimax point r≈0.064315108, |mu|≈0.437863195 and signal≈0.164372899, plus epsilon≈0.066179495 at n=684, delta=.005 and positive floor proxy≈0.032013909. Two alpha=.02 and two delta=.005 events union-bound to .05 without independence. This strongly supports the mechanism and budget arithmetic, but the all-KL>=1 floor remains numerical rather than interval/analytic certified, and same-reference learned standardization is outside the directly supported fixed-score contract.
